Header: Colletotrichum falcatum ( Glomerella tucumanensis ) Akher Lal patcha rog

Prevention: Use a tolerant/ resistant variety, e.g.
Crop rotation: practise at 2-year intervals growing a non-grass crop

Collect seed setts from disease free field; or use certified seed setts; or hot air treatment of setts at 54°C & 95% humidity for 4hrs; or hot water treatment at 50-52°C for 2 hrs; or treat setts with fungicide (see yellow section)
Field sanitation & proper weed control especially grass weeds
Maintain good drainage system in the field
Do not allow irrigation water to flow from diseased fields to healthy fields
Avoid low land for sugarcane cultivation.
Monitoring: Field visit every week to look for the diagnostic symptom: red streak with ash grey center in the mid rib
Observe withering of the 3rd & 4th leaves from the top; later the whole plant may droop
Look out for alternate reddish and whitish lesions inside the stem when you have split it longitudinally
Direct Control: Roguing of infected plants at early crop stage and destroy through burning
Restrictions: Wear correct clothes when handling pesticides
